raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for your engagement with Cedar Systems. We noticed some conflicting information regarding the status of your project. Earlier, your facilities management team requested discovery about regional coordination, but the latest call indicates the project is paused and there is disagreement about the requirement.

To ensure we align properly and provide the best support, could you please clarify the current project status and requirements? This will help us proceed effectively and schedule any necessary discussions at the right time.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the current status of the project?
Are there any updated requirements or concerns that need to be addressed?
uncertainties: There is a contradiction between the earlier inquiry and the latest call regarding the project status and requirements.
